caveats: SAIDI measures duration per customer and SAIFI interruptions per customer, not total outage minutes or total incidents. The workbooks include planned outages, breakdowns and transmission failures; licensees use different feeder and customer-count assumptions, and some assumptions omit unreported faults or use planned durations. Read the original Assumptions worksheets when comparing areas. Utility geographies differ from administrative boundaries. Provincial and division indices overlap area observations and cannot be summed or averaged without customer weights. Raw numeric cell values, displayed tokens and cached formulas are preserved; formulas are not recalculated. Hasalaka is labelled Proposed and its source zeros do not establish operating reliability. The LECO sheet linked as 2025 Q1 prints 2024 as its duration year and September in a frequency column; all 42 LECO observations from that file remain undated. Its duration unit is hours per customer, while the other duration sections specify minutes. No silent date correction or unit conversion is made.
Blank cells and spreadsheet errors remain null. Numeric cells retain their raw cached value, displayed token and formula, without recalculation. Units and calendar conflicts remain explicit.
grain: One published monthly reliability index by source report, division, operating geography and index; conflicting calendar periods remain null
notes: PUCSL’s quarterly workbooks publish monthly System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) and System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) values for CEB’s four distribution divisions and LECO. They include utility-province and service-area detail as well as published division totals. This series covers July 2024 to March 2026. The 2024 Q4 CEB sheets separate interruption causes; their total columns are used here.
